limitations: Official executables append an ELF snapshot at original file offset0x43c000; Mach-O runner text is not total Dart code. ELF exact extraction bounded by section/segment extents and original/source hashes.

Official ELF full-image Ghidra pseudocode genuinely returned; its Listing assembly and callgraph returned empty despite observed functions. Preserved refusals/empty evidence, then real assembly obtained through exact function-sized ARM64 raw windows. Window assembly covers every original symbol byte; external data/functions are absent, so raw-window decompilation and callgraph are partial.
Ghidra rebases official ELF by0x100000; initial assembly/callgraph queries on unrebased addresses were rejected. Rebased retries preserved, no invalid input classified as success.
Official pseudocode warnings include unknown calling convention. C is heuristic, not recovered Dart semantics. Raw-window warnings include absent external memory/PIC/flow.

Forge color raw-window pseudocode explicitly failed with response buffer size exceeded. Full-image color pseudocode capped/canceled while live after autoanalysis; only full assembly returned. This is not successful Forge color C decompilation.

Initial default Forge full-image trial at unlabelled/interior address canceled while constant propagation costly; later full-image analysis disabled Basic Constant Reference Analyzer, recorded in REA profile. Varnode warnings/errors preserved.
Mapped BL targets separate physical target addresses from repeated display names. LLVM OUTLINED_FUNCTION calls are not equivalent to Dart-level allocations/typechecks.
Companion .c replaces literal escaped newline sequences with line breaks only for readability; original structured JSON remains authoritative.
No binaries, extracted ELF or raw binary windows included in durable evidence/upload; all remain local SSD.
findings: convertFormatValue: Forge43376B vs SDK8452B; native body3265BL+5BLR includes repeated tiny outlined helpers. Exact-target top OUTLINED1548 at0x1010cabe0×235, OUTLINED1514 at0x1010caa7c×178, df.context.slow at0x1010c3260×150. This does not prove runtime cost.

Benchmark Node.count688B vs220B and tree436B vs108B. Native pseudocode/assembly shows shadow-root linked TLS frame and pending-exception branches; overflow/boxing/stack-overflow slow paths remain required absent a proof.
Benchmark JSON stringifier13684B vs1360B; native has173BL+31BLR, including runtime class/selector dispatch and multiple stringifier subclass targets. User json kernel8612B vs1644B,149BL+16BLR.

Root retention-chains.json independently records cross-domain convert selector retention; that reachability evidence is separate from within-function bloat and does not prove there are no genuine image callers.
